name: Amir Etemadieh
biography: ( ) is a Research Scientist on the R&D team at Accuvant LABS. Amir founded the GTVHacker group which has released public exploits for every device within the Google TV platform as well as multiple other non-Google TV devices including The Roku Media Player and The Google Chromecast. Prior to starting GTVHacker, Amir conducted independent research on a long list of consumer devices and is currently listed on multiple "Security Hall of Fame" pages for successfully completing bug bounties.
